summary: This file is a configuration dictionary (no callable code). It defines an MMClassification model config for an ImageClassifier with an InceptionV3 backbone (1000 classes, no auxiliary logits), a ClsHead with CrossEntropyLoss, and top-1/top-5 evaluation metrics.
